052/**
053 * An {@link Instances} implementation that is based on scopes.
054 *
055 * @author <a href="https://about.me/lairdnelson" target="_top">Laird Nelson</a>
056 */
057public final class ScopedInstances implements Instances {
058
059  private final Domain domain;
060
061  private final ConcurrentMap<AttributedType, Bean<?>> scopeletBeanCache;
062
063  private final Reducible<AttributedType, Bean<?>> scopeletReducible;
064
065  private final TypeMirror scopeletType;
066
067  /**
068   * Creates a new {@link ScopedInstances}.
069   *
070   * @param domain a {@link Domain}; must not be {@code null}
071   *
072   * @param selectable a {@link Selectable} used to select {@link Scopelet}s; must not be {@code null}
073   *
074   * @param reducer a {@link Reducer} used to disambiguate {@linkplain Scopelet#active() active} {@link Scopelet}s; must
075   * not be {@code null}
076   *
077   * @exception NullPointerException if any argument is {@code null}
078   */
079  public ScopedInstances(final Domain domain,
080                         final Selectable<AttributedType, Bean<?>> selectable,
081                         final Reducer<AttributedType, Bean<?>> reducer) {
082    super();
083    final ConcurrentMap<AttributedType, Bean<?>> scopeletBeanCache = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
084    this.scopeletBeanCache = scopeletBeanCache;
085    this.scopeletReducible =
086      Reducible.<AttributedType, Bean<?>>ofCaching(selectable, reducer, ScopedInstances::handleInactiveScopelets, scopeletBeanCache::computeIfAbsent);
087    this.scopeletType = domain.declaredType(null, domain.typeElement(Scopelet.class.getCanonicalName()), domain.wildcardType());
088    this.domain = domain;
089  }
090
091  @Override // Instances (AutoCloseable)
092  public final void close() {
093    this.scopeletBeanCache.clear();
094  }
095
096  /**
097   * Finds and returns the <dfn>nearest</dfn> scope identifier in the forest represented by the supplied {@link
098   * Attributes}.
099   *
100   * @param c a {@link Collection} of {@link Attributes}; must not be {@code null}
101   *
102   * @return the <dfn>nearest</dfn> scope identifier in the forest represented by the supplied {@link
103   * Attributes}, or {@code null}
104   *
105   * @exception NullPointerException if {@code c} is {@code null}
106   */
107  protected Attributes findScopeId(final Collection<? extends Attributes> c) {
108    if (c.isEmpty()) {
109      return null;
110    }
111    // Breadth first on purpose. Scope Attributes closer to the Attributes they attribute win over Scope Attributes
112    // further away.
113    final Queue<Attributes> q = new ArrayDeque<>(c);
114    while (!q.isEmpty()) {
115      final Attributes a = q.poll();
116      if (this.isScopeId(a)) {
117        return a;
118      }
119      q.addAll(a.attributes());
120    }
121    return null;
122  }
123
124  /**
125   * Returns {@code true} if and only if the supplied {@link Attributes} is deemed to be an identifier of a
126   * <dfn>scope</dfn>.
127   *
128   * @param a an {@link Attributes}; must not be {@code null}
129   *
130   * @return {@code true} if and only if the supplied {@link Attributes} is deemed to be an identifier of a scope
131   *
132   * @exception NullPointerException if {@code a} is {@code null}
133   */
134  protected boolean isScopeId(final Attributes a) {
135    boolean scopeFound = false;
136    boolean qualifierFound = false;
137    for (final Attributes a0 : a.attributes()) {
138      if (scopeFound) {
139        if (!qualifierFound && a0.equals(qualifier())) {
140          return true;
141        }
142      } else if (qualifierFound) {
143        if (a0.equals(Scopelet.SCOPE)) {
144          return true;
145        }
146      } else if (a0.equals(Scopelet.SCOPE)) {
147        scopeFound = true;
148      } else if (a0.equals(qualifier())) {
149        qualifierFound = true;
150      }
151    }
152    return false;
153  }
154
155  private final boolean normal(final Attributes a) {
156    final BooleanValue v = a.value("normal");
157    return v != null && v.value();
158  }
159
160  @Override // Instances
161  public boolean proxiable(final Request<?> r) {
162    if (r.primordial()) {
163      return false;
164    }
165    final Id id = r.beanReduction().bean().id();
166    if (!id.types().proxiable()) {
167      return false;
168    }
169    final Attributes scopeId = this.findScopeId(id.attributes());
170    return scopeId != null && this.normal(scopeId);
171  }
172
173  @Override // Instances (InstanceRemover)
174  public final boolean remove(final Id id) {
175    return id != null && this.scopelet(this.scopeletBeanReduction(this.findScopeId(id.attributes()))).remove(id);
176  }
177
178  // Called by #remove(Id)
179  private final Scopelet<?> scopelet(final BeanReduction<Scopelet<?>> scopeletBeanReduction) {
180    return this.scopelet(scopeletBeanReduction, null);
181  }
182
183  // Yes, you need the BeanReduction parameter, not just Bean, because you're going to call r.newChild(BeanReduction)
184  private final Scopelet<?> scopelet(final BeanReduction<Scopelet<?>> scopeletBeanReduction, final Request<?> r) {
185    final Bean<Scopelet<?>> scopeletBean = scopeletBeanReduction.bean();
186    final BeanReduction<Scopelet<?>> governingScopeletBeanReduction =
187      this.scopeletBeanReduction(this.findScopeId(scopeletBean.id().attributes()));
188    if (scopeletBean.equals(governingScopeletBeanReduction.bean())) {
189      final Factory<Scopelet<?>> scopeletFactory = scopeletBean.factory();
190      final Scopelet<?> scopelet = scopeletFactory.singleton();
191      return
192        scopelet == null ?
193        scopeletFactory.create(r == null ? null : r.child(scopeletBeanReduction)) :
194        scopelet;
195    }
196    return scopelet(governingScopeletBeanReduction, r); // recurse
197  }
198
199  private final BeanReduction<Scopelet<?>> scopeletBeanReduction(final Attributes scopeId) {
200    final AttributedType scopeletAttributedType = new AttributedType(this.scopeletType, List.of(scopeId));
201    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
202    final Bean<Scopelet<?>> scopeletBean = (Bean<Scopelet<?>>)this.scopeletReducible.reduce(scopeletAttributedType);
203    if (scopeletBean == null) {
204      throw new UnsatisfiedReductionException(scopeletAttributedType, null, null);
205    }
206    return new BeanReduction<>(scopeletAttributedType, scopeletBean);
207  }
208
209  @Override // Instances
210  @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
211  public final <I> Supplier<? extends I> supplier(final Request<I> request) {
212    if (request.primordial()) {
213      final I instance = (I)request;
214      return () -> instance;
215    }
216    final Bean<I> bean = request.beanReduction().bean();
217    final Factory<I> factory = bean.factory();
218    final I singleton = factory.singleton();
219    if (singleton == null) {
220      final Id id = bean.id();
221      final BeanReduction<Scopelet<?>> scopeletBeanReduction = this.scopeletBeanReduction(this.findScopeId(id.attributes()));
222      if (bean.equals(scopeletBeanReduction.bean())) {
223        return () -> factory.create(request);
224      }
225      final Scopelet<?> scopelet = this.scopelet(scopeletBeanReduction, request);
226      assert scopelet != null;
227      return () -> scopelet.instance(id, factory, request);
228    }
229    return factory::singleton;
230  }
231
232
233  /*
234   * Static methods.
235   */
236
237
238  // Invoked by method reference only
239  private static final Bean<?> handleInactiveScopelets(final Collection<? extends Bean<?>> beans,
240                                                       final AttributedType attributedType) {
241    if (beans.size() < 2) { // 2 because we're disambiguating
242      throw new IllegalArgumentException("beans: " + beans);
243    }
244    Bean<?> b2 = null;
245    Scopelet<?> s2 = null;
246    final Iterator<? extends Bean<?>> i = beans.iterator(); // we use Iterator for good reasons
247    while (i.hasNext()) {
248      final Bean<?> b1 = i.next();
249      if (b1.factory() instanceof Scopelet<?> s1) {
250        if (s2 == null) {
251          assert b2 == null;
252          if (i.hasNext()) {
253            b2 = i.next();
254            if (b2.factory() instanceof Scopelet<?> s) {
255              s2 = s;
256            } else {
257              s2 = null;
258              b2 = null;
259              break;
260            }
261          } else {
262            s2 = s1;
263            b2 = b1;
264            break;
265          }
266        }
267        assert b2 != null;
268        if (s2.scopeId().equals(s1.scopeId())) {
269          if (s2.active()) {
270            if (s1.active()) {
271              throw new TooManyActiveScopeletsException("scopelet1: " + s1 + "; scopelet2: " + s2);
272            }
273            // drop s1; keep s2
274          } else if (s1.active()) {
275            // drop s2; keep s1
276            s2 = s1;
277            b2 = b1;
278          } else {
279            // both are inactive; drop 'em both and keep going
280            s2 = null;
281            b2 = null;
282          }
283        } else {
284          s2 = null;
285          b2 = null;
286          break;
287        }
288      } else {
289        s2 = null;
290        b2 = null;
291        break;
292      }
293    }
294    if (s2 == null) {
295      throw new AmbiguousReductionException(attributedType,
296                                             beans,
297                                             "TODO: this message needs to be better; can't resolve these alternates: " + beans);
298    }
299    assert b2 != null;
300    return b2;
301  }
